classification: Ten failed outcomes, not ten independent vulnerabilities: six relation/activity refusals missing, three audit-failure cases and one coherent cycle missing three audit records. Its physical balance and movement assertions had passed.
auditFailure: The SQL audit trigger refusal surfaced as Prisma P2003 in the old best-effort logger and was swallowed; this is not evidence of an actual missing foreign key.
oracleEvolution: Eight cases later added for same-timestamp stored changes, foreign suppliers on held reservations, simulated P2034 and replay. The coherent-cycle title was corrected from three to four audits; its four-action assertion was unchanged.
